records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Data Center revenue was up 14% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially, led by growing demand for generative AI and large language models using GPUs based on our NVIDIA Hopper and Ampere architectures.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fueled by the sustained demand for exceptional 3D graphics and the scale of the gaming market, NVIDIA has leveraged its GPU architecture to create platforms for scientific computing, AI, data science, autonomous vehicles, robotics, metaverse and 3D internet applications.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The year-on-year decrease reflects weaker demand due to the macroeconomic slowdown and lower shipments to normalize channel inventory levels.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin declined from a year earlier and increased sequentially.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The year-on-year decrease reflects $8.04 billion in stock repurchases, partially offset by operating cash flow generation.
